defined:
run NegativeParallelPaths {
    some disj H1, H2, H3, H4 : Human | some disj M1 : Material | some disj C1 : Component | some disj W1, W2 : Workstation - (begin + end) {
        Workstation = begin + end + W1 + W2
        Worker = Human + Robot
        Human = H1 + H2 + H3 + H4
        Robot = none
        Material = M1
        Component = C1
        Product = M1 + C1
        Dangerous = none
        workers = begin->H1 + W1->H2 + W2->H3 + end->H4
        // Two alternative routes begin -> W1 -> end and begin -> W2 -> end
        succ = begin->W1 + begin->W2 + W1->end + W2->end
        parts = C1->M1
        workstation = C1->begin
    }
} for 4 Workstation, 4 Worker, 2 Product expect 0

run NegativeDisconnectedLoop {
    some disj H1, H2, H3 : Human | some disj M1 : Material | some disj C1 : Component | some disj W1 : Workstation - (begin + end) {
        Workstation = begin + end + W1
        Worker = Human + Robot
        Human = H1 + H2 + H3
        Robot = none
        Material = M1
        Component = C1
        Product = M1 + C1
        Dangerous = none
        workers = begin->H1 + end->H2 + W1->H3
        // begin -> end is a line, but W1 loops on itself and is not part of it
        succ = begin->end + W1->W1
        parts = C1->M1
        workstation = C1->begin
    }
} for 3 Workstation, 3 Worker, 2 Product expect 0

run NegativeShortcut {
    some disj H1, H2, H3 : Human | some disj M1 : Material | some disj C1 : Component | some disj W1 : Workstation - (begin + end) {
        Workstation = begin + end + W1
        Worker = Human + Robot
        Human = H1 + H2 + H3
        Robot = none
        Material = M1
        Component = C1
        Product = M1 + C1
        Dangerous = none
        workers = begin->H1 + W1->H2 + end->H3
        // Two distinct paths from begin to end, so the stations do not form a single line
        succ = begin->W1 + W1->end + begin->end
        parts = C1->M1
        workstation = C1->begin
    }
} for 3 Workstation, 3 Worker, 2 Product expect 0
